tip: A 50 gallon Hot Liquor Tank with a sight gauge.
notes: The OakBarn Big MAC HLT, a Skynet Vessel Widget (OakBarn Brewery, 2026-11-24): a 50 gallon HLT, 24 in wide and 25.5 in tall. A sight gauge on the Left with TC ports at its Top and Bottom; a Tangential at the Left wall; a TC 2 Thermowell (temperature probe) at the Left Back; two drains, Front Low and Bottom Center; the Heating Element (TC 2) at the Right Back; a pressure type Volume Sensor in a box on the Right side (a mark, its Volume Meter Device picked on the Tab). Its IPs are built in on the ports.
